(a) If you’re after something tasty but not too heavy, you might enjoy choices like a herbal tea latte, a fruit smoothie, or sparkling water with fresh lemon. These can provide a pleasant café experience while keeping things light.
(b) Given your mild hypertension, you might enjoy options that are lower in caffeine and sodium but still offer good flavour — perhaps a rooibos latte with a touch of honey, a fresh berry smoothie made without added sugar, or a sparkling water infused with citrus. These can provide a pleasant café experience without leaning too heavy or overly stimulating.
(c) Given your lactose intolerance, you might enjoy options that are dairy-free but still offer good flavour — perhaps an almond milk flat white, a coconut matcha latte, or a fruit iced tea. These can provide a pleasant café experience without leaning too heavy or upsetting digestion.
(d) Given your love for artisan coffee as a Melbourne local, you might enjoy options that highlight well-sourced beans without being overly filling — perhaps a piccolo latte, a long black, or a single origin pour-over. These can provide a pleasant café experience while showcasing quality flavour notes.
